description: A profile's run-level `model: locked-model` makes every prompt explicit (`model_locked`), so a per-effect `routing: high` pin on `ask` is never consulted either: meta.model is the locked run model, model_reason: "default" (the effect names no model of its own), and meta.complexity.band is the effect's own scored band ("low"), not the pinned "high" row the natural score doesn't reach.
